summary: A statement of policy from the Internet Activities Board on the proper use of Internet resources. It is a short policy statement and not a technical specification.

eli5.summary: The people in charge wrote down a short rule about how to behave on the shared network, like a note about playing nicely on the playground.

questions: what is unethical use of the internet
why is responsible internet use important
subtitle: IAB statement on responsible use of network resources

tldr.problem: The Internet has grown into a critical national resource used by thousands of researchers, and misuse threatens its continued availability.
tldr.mechanism: The Internet Activities Board published a policy statement listing five categories of unethical activities: unauthorized access, disruption of service, resource waste, destruction of information integrity, and privacy violations.
tldr.outcome: This remains the foundational policy on Internet conduct, emphasizing that users bear responsibility for protecting the system's health and reliability.

today: RFC 1087 established the foundational ethical principles for Internet conduct that remain relevant today. It remains the IAB's statement on responsible use of network resources.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: The Internet Activities Board (IAB) issued this statement in January 1989 to address misuse of the Internet, a shared national infrastructure built with government, industry and academic resources. The memo emphasizes that the Internet's utility depends on its wide availability, and that irresponsible use poses an enormous threat to its continued operation and benefit to the research community.
sections.eli5: The Internet was built by many people working together. Bad behavior puts everyone's work at risk, so the leaders had to remind people to behave responsibly.

sections.title: Unethical Activities
sections.content:
The IAB identifies five categories of unethical and unacceptable activities. Unauthorized access seeks to gain entry to resources without permission. Service disruption interferes with the intended use of the Internet. Resource waste squanders people, computing capacity or storage. Information destruction corrupts or damages computer-based data. Privacy violation compromises the confidentiality of user communications and data.

Researchers using the Internet have special responsibility to exercise caution in their experiments, since network-wide research can affect all users and components.
sections.eli5: The five rules are: no sneaking in, no breaking things, no wasting electricity, no ruining files, and no reading other people's mail. Researchers doing experiments have to be extra careful not to break the whole network.

sections.title: User Responsibility
sections.content: The statement makes clear that access to the Internet is a privilege, not a right. The health and well-being of the Internet ultimately depend on users themselves guarding against abuses and protecting the system's long-term viability. While the IAB plans to work with federal agencies to improve technical security and resilience, such measures can be expensive and may hinder the free flow of information that makes the Internet valuable.
sections.eli5: Using the Internet is a special privilege, not something you automatically get. Everyone using it has to help protect it and not break it.
